content:
Paul, Silas and Timothy,
    
    To the church of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:
    
    Grace and peace to you.

teaching.name: Greetings to the Thessalonians

content: We always thank God for all of you and continually mention you in our prayers.

teaching.name: Greetings to the Thessalonians

content: We remember before our God and Father your work produced by faith, your labor prompted by love, and your endurance inspired by hope in our Lord Jesus Christ.

teaching.name: Greetings to the Thessalonians

content: For we know, brothers and sisters loved by God, that he has chosen you,

teaching.name: Greetings to the Thessalonians

content: because our gospel came to you not simply with words but also with power, with the Holy Spirit and deep conviction. You know how we lived among you for your sake.

teaching.name: Coming of Christ as an Inspiring Hope

content: You became imitators of us and of the Lord, for you welcomed the message in the midst of severe suffering with the joy given by the Holy Spirit.

teaching.name: Coming of Christ as an Inspiring Hope

content: And so you became a model to all the believers in Macedonia and Achaia.

teaching.name: Coming of Christ as an Inspiring Hope

content: The Lord’s message rang out from you not only in Macedonia and Achaia—your faith in God has become known everywhere. Therefore we do not need to say anything about it,

teaching.name: Coming of Christ as an Inspiring Hope

content: for they themselves report what kind of reception you gave us. They tell how you turned to God from idols to serve the living and true God,

teaching.name: Coming of Christ as an Inspiring Hope

content: and to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead—Jesus, who rescues us from the coming wrath.

teaching.name: Coming of Christ as an Inspiring Hope

content: You know, brothers and sisters, that our visit to you was not without results.

teaching.name: Coming of Jesus Christ gives us a Working Hope

content: We had previously suffered and been treated outrageously in Philippi, as you know, but with the help of our God we dared to tell you his gospel in the face of strong opposition.

teaching.name: Coming of Jesus Christ gives us a Working Hope

content: For the appeal we make does not spring from error or impure motives, nor are we trying to trick you.

teaching.name: Coming of Jesus Christ gives us a Working Hope

content: On the contrary, we speak as those approved by God to be entrusted with the gospel. We are not trying to please people but God, who tests our hearts.

teaching.name: Coming of Jesus Christ gives us a Working Hope

content: You know we never used flattery, nor did we put on a mask to cover up greed—God is our witness.

teaching.name: Coming of Jesus Christ gives us a Working Hope

content: We were not looking for praise from people, not from you or anyone else, even though as apostles of Christ we could have asserted our authority.

teaching.name: Coming of Jesus Christ gives us a Working Hope

content:
Instead, we were like young children among you.
    Just as a nursing mother cares for her children,

teaching.name: Coming of Jesus Christ gives us a Working Hope

content: so we cared for you. Because we loved you so much, we were delighted to share with you not only the gospel of God but our lives as well.

teaching.name: Coming of Jesus Christ gives us a Working Hope

content: Surely you remember, brothers and sisters, our toil and hardship; we worked night and day in order not to be a burden to anyone while we preached the gospel of God to you.

teaching.name: Coming of Jesus Christ gives us a Working Hope

content: You are witnesses, and so is God, of how holy, righteous and blameless we were among you who believed.

teaching.name: Coming of Jesus Christ gives us a Working Hope

content: For you know that we dealt with each of you as a father deals with his own children,

teaching.name: Coming of Jesus Christ gives us a Working Hope

content: encouraging, comforting and urging you to live lives worthy of God, who calls you into his kingdom and glory.

teaching.name: Coming of Jesus Christ gives us a Working Hope

content: And we also thank God continually because, when you received the word of God, which you heard from us, you accepted it not as a human word, but as it actually is, the word of God, which is indeed at work in you who believe.

teaching.name: Coming of Christ as a Working Hope

content: For you, brothers and sisters, became imitators of God’s churches in Judea, which are in Christ Jesus: You suffered from your own people the same things those churches suffered from the Jews

teaching.name: Coming of Christ as a Working Hope

content: who killed the Lord Jesus and the prophets and also drove us out. They displease God and are hostile to everyone

teaching.name: Coming of Christ as a Working Hope

content: in their effort to keep us from speaking to the Gentiles so that they may be saved. In this way they always heap up their sins to the limit. The wrath of God has come upon them at last.

teaching.name: Coming of Christ as a Working Hope

content: But, brothers and sisters, when we were orphaned by being separated from you for a short time (in person, not in thought), out of our intense longing we made every effort to see you.

teaching.name: Coming of Christ as a Working Hope

content: For we wanted to come to you—certainly I, Paul, did, again and again—but Satan blocked our way.

teaching.name: Coming of Christ as a Working Hope

content: For what is our hope, our joy, or the crown in which we will glory in the presence of our Lord Jesus when he comes? Is it not you?

teaching.name: Coming of Christ as a Working Hope

content: Indeed, you are our glory and joy.

teaching.name: Coming of Christ as a Working Hope

content: So when we could stand it no longer, we thought it best to be left by ourselves in Athens.

teaching.name: The Coming of Christ is a purifying Hope 1

content: We sent Timothy, who is our brother and co-worker in God’s service in spreading the gospel of Christ, to strengthen and encourage you in your faith,

teaching.name: The Coming of Christ is a purifying Hope 1

content: so that no one would be unsettled by these trials. For you know quite well that we are destined for them.

teaching.name: The Coming of Christ is a purifying Hope 1

content: In fact, when we were with you, we kept telling you that we would be persecuted. And it turned out that way, as you well know.

teaching.name: The Coming of Christ is a purifying Hope 1

content: For this reason, when I could stand it no longer, I sent to find out about your faith. I was afraid that in some way the tempter had tempted you and that our labors might have been in vain.

teaching.name: The Coming of Christ is a purifying Hope 1

content: But Timothy has just now come to us from you and has brought good news about your faith and love. He has told us that you always have pleasant memories of us and that you long to see us, just as we also long to see you.

teaching.name: The Coming of Christ is a purifying Hope 1

content: Therefore, brothers and sisters, in all our distress and persecution we were encouraged about you because of your faith.

teaching.name: The Coming of Christ is a purifying Hope 1

content: For now we really live, since you are standing firm in the Lord.

teaching.name: The Coming of Christ is a purifying Hope 1

content: How can we thank God enough for you in return for all the joy we have in the presence of our God because of you?

teaching.name: The Coming of Christ is a purifying Hope 1

content: Night and day we pray most earnestly that we may see you again and supply what is lacking in your faith.

teaching.name: The Coming of Christ is a purifying Hope 1

content: Now may our God and Father himself and our Lord Jesus clear the way for us to come to you.

teaching.name: The Coming of Christ is a purifying Hope 1

content: May the Lord make your love increase and overflow for each other and for everyone else, just as ours does for you.

teaching.name: The Coming of Christ is a purifying Hope 1

content: May he strengthen your hearts so that you will be blameless and holy in the presence of our God and Father when our Lord Jesus comes with all his holy ones.

teaching.name: The Coming of Christ is a purifying Hope 1

content: As for other matters, brothers and sisters, we instructed you how to live in order to please God, as in fact you are living. Now we ask you and urge you in the Lord Jesus to do this more and more.

teaching.name: The Coming of Christ is a purifying Hope 2

content: For you know what instructions we gave you by the authority of the Lord Jesus.

teaching.name: The Coming of Christ is a purifying Hope 2

content: It is God’s will that you should be sanctified: that you should avoid sexual immorality;

teaching.name: The Coming of Christ is a purifying Hope 2

content: that each of you should learn to control your own body in a way that is holy and honorable,

teaching.name: The Coming of Christ is a purifying Hope 2

content: not in passionate lust like the pagans, who do not know God;

teaching.name: The Coming of Christ is a purifying Hope 2

content: and that in this matter no one should wrong or take advantage of a brother or sister. The Lord will punish all those who commit such sins, as we told you and warned you before.

teaching.name: The Coming of Christ is a purifying Hope 2

content: For God did not call us to be impure, but to live a holy life.

teaching.name: The Coming of Christ is a purifying Hope 2

content: Therefore, anyone who rejects this instruction does not reject a human being but God, the very God who gives you his Holy Spirit.

teaching.name: The Coming of Christ is a purifying Hope 2

content: Now about your love for one another we do not need to write to you, for you yourselves have been taught by God to love each other.

teaching.name: The Coming of Christ is a purifying Hope 2

content: And in fact, you do love all of God’s family throughout Macedonia. Yet we urge you, brothers and sisters, to do so more and more,

teaching.name: The Coming of Christ is a purifying Hope 2

content: and to make it your ambition to lead a quiet life: You should mind your own business and work with your hands, just as we told you,

teaching.name: The Coming of Christ is a purifying Hope 2

content: so that your daily life may win the respect of outsiders and so that you will not be dependent on anybody.

teaching.name: The Coming of Christ is a purifying Hope 2

content: Brothers and sisters, we do not want you to be uninformed about those who sleep in death, so that you do not grieve like the rest of mankind, who have no hope.

teaching.name: The Coming of Christ is a comforting Hope

content: For we believe that Jesus died and rose again, and so we believe that God will bring with Jesus those who have fallen asleep in him.

teaching.name: The Coming of Christ is a comforting Hope

content: According to the Lord’s word, we tell you that we who are still alive, who are left until the coming of the Lord, will certainly not precede those who have fallen asleep.

teaching.name: The Coming of Christ is a comforting Hope

content: For the Lord himself will come down from heaven, with a loud command, with the voice of the archangel and with the trumpet call of God, and the dead in Christ will rise first.

teaching.name: The Coming of Christ is a comforting Hope

content: After that, we who are still alive and are left will be caught up together with them in the clouds to meet the Lord in the air. And so we will be with the Lord forever.

teaching.name: The Coming of Christ is a comforting Hope

content: Therefore encourage one another with these words.

teaching.name: The Coming of Christ is a comforting Hope

content: Now, brothers and sisters, about times and dates we do not need to write to you,

teaching.name: The Coming of Christ is arousing Hope

content: for you know very well that the day of the Lord will come like a thief in the night.

teaching.name: The Coming of Christ is arousing Hope

content: While people are saying, “Peace and safety,” destruction will come on them suddenly, as labor pains on a pregnant woman, and they will not escape.

teaching.name: The Coming of Christ is arousing Hope

content: But you, brothers and sisters, are not in darkness so that this day should surprise you like a thief.

teaching.name: The Coming of Christ is arousing Hope

content: You are all children of the light and children of the day. We do not belong to the night or to the darkness.

teaching.name: The Coming of Christ is arousing Hope

content: So then, let us not be like others, who are asleep, but let us be awake and sober.

teaching.name: The Coming of Christ is arousing Hope

content: For those who sleep, sleep at night, and those who get drunk, get drunk at night.

teaching.name: The Coming of Christ is arousing Hope

content: But since we belong to the day, let us be sober, putting on faith and love as a breastplate, and the hope of salvation as a helmet.

teaching.name: The Coming of Christ is arousing Hope

content: For God did not appoint us to suffer wrath but to receive salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ.

teaching.name: The Coming of Christ is arousing Hope

content: He died for us so that, whether we are awake or asleep, we may live together with him.

teaching.name: The Coming of Christ is arousing Hope

content: Therefore encourage one another and build each other up, just as in fact you are doing.

teaching.name: Commandments for Christians

content: Now we ask you, brothers and sisters, to acknowledge those who work hard among you, who care for you in the Lord and who admonish you.

teaching.name: Commandments for Christians

content: Hold them in the highest regard in love because of their work. Live in peace with each other.

teaching.name: Commandments for Christians

content: And we urge you, brothers and sisters, warn those who are idle and disruptive, encourage the disheartened, help the weak, be patient with everyone.

teaching.name: Commandments for Christians

content: Make sure that nobody pays back wrong for wrong, but always strive to do what is good for each other and for everyone else.

teaching.name: Commandments for Christians

content: Rejoice always,

teaching.name: Commandments for Christians

content: pray continually,

teaching.name: Commandments for Christians

content: give thanks in all circumstances; for this is God’s will for you in Christ Jesus.

teaching.name: Commandments for Christians

content: Do not quench the Spirit.

teaching.name: Commandments for Christians

content: Do not treat prophecies with contempt

teaching.name: Commandments for Christians

content: but test them all; hold on to what is good,

teaching.name: Commandments for Christians

content: reject every kind of evil.

teaching.name: Commandments for Christians

content: May God himself, the God of peace, sanctify you through and through. May your whole spirit, soul and body be kept blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.

teaching.name: Commandments for Christians

content: The one who calls you is faithful, and he will do it.

teaching.name: Commandments for Christians

content: Brothers and sisters, pray for us.

teaching.name: Commandments for Christians

content: Greet all God’s people with a holy kiss.

teaching.name: Commandments for Christians

content: I charge you before the Lord to have this letter read to all the brothers and sisters.

teaching.name: Commandments for Christians

content: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.

teaching.name: Commandments for Christians
